payload.text:
Wohngeldstelle Berlin
Bescheid vom 20.08.2026
Ihr Antrag wird abgelehnt.
Begründung: Die eingereichten Unterlagen seien nicht vollständig. Die Behörde verweist auf § 39 VwVfG.
Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung: Bitte beachten Sie die im Originalbescheid genannte Rechtsbehelfsfrist und zuständige Stelle.

payload.summary: The safest first step is to verify the actual rent notice, calculation basis and dates before accepting or contesting the increase.

claims.text: A rent increase cannot be assessed responsibly without the notice, dates, old/new rent and stated legal/calculation basis.

action.title: Check the rent notice before responding
action.why: Separate the landlord's stated basis, dates and amounts from what the current official rules and local comparison data support.

uncertainties: This golden scenario does not determine whether a specific rent increase is legally valid.
A full workflow needs the actual notice plus current applicable tenancy-law retrieval.

payload.summary: Preserve the original digital evidence first, then choose the safest reporting/support route based on urgency.

claims.text: Evidence can disappear after content is deleted or reported, so preservation should precede platform reporting where safe and lawful.

action.title: Preserve the evidence safely first
action.why: Keep message/content context, dates, usernames and URLs before reporting or blocking; use emergency services for acute threats.

uncertainties: CivicOS does not decide whether conduct constitutes a criminal offence.
Do not capture or redistribute illegal sexual-abuse material; contact police instead.

payload.summary: Identify the official service first, then resolve the responsible authority and location-specific office from that service record.

claims.text: Authority routing should be grounded in an official service/authority record rather than guessed from the user's wording.

action.title: Resolve the official service and responsible authority
action.why: The ServicePortal links administrative services to responsible bodies; start from the service record and location facts.

uncertainties: A generic question can map to multiple services; CivicOS must not invent one responsible authority without enough case context.

payload.summary: Identify the record-holding Berlin public body and make the information request specific enough to locate the records.

claims.text: A Berlin information-access request should be directed to the public body that holds the requested records, with the records described as specifically as possible.

action.title: Prepare a specific records request to the record-holding body
action.why: Name the decision/topic, time period and records sought, then verify the correct public body before sending.

uncertainties: Exceptions, fees and other legal regimes can affect access; this scenario does not determine final disclosure entitlement.

payload.summary: Keep the control relationship unresolved until dated primary records explain whether the disagreement is a real contradiction or a time-version difference.

claims.text: Conflicting control/director records should remain disputed until source dates, identifiers and legal entities are reconciled.

action.title: Compare dated primary register records
action.why: Check stable legal-entity identifiers and validity dates before choosing either control claim.

uncertainties: Different directors/controllers at different dates may both be correct.
A relationship conflict is not evidence of wrongdoing.

payload.summary: Resolve the exact permit/service, responsible authority and required evidence before diagnosing where a case is blocked.

claims.text: Permit routing should begin from the exact official service and location, not a guessed department name.

action.title: Resolve service → authority → evidence → current handoff
action.why: A reliable blocker diagnosis requires the official service record, responsible office and case's current workflow stage.

uncertainties: This scenario does not infer a department or approval path without an exact service and location.

payload.summary: Verify the changed provision and effective date, then map only evidence-linked services/cases into the impact set before changing guidance.

claims.text: A detected text change does not establish operational impact until the changed provision, effective date and affected services/cases are linked.

action.title: Verify the rule change, then rerun affected services/cases
action.why: Separate publication/text change from legal effective date and operational impact; use the dependency graph to select reruns.

uncertainties: A changed legal text is not automatically applicable to every existing case.
Operational guidance should not update until affected golden cases pass review.
